stops.quote: In the Neusiedler See-Seewinkel National Park , birdwatchers move gently and quietly.

stops.name: Neusiedl
stops.quote: Lake Neusiedl has been known as the "Sea of the Viennese" since 1927, when the first bathing facility opened in Neusiedl - today a modern, well-kept, quiet lido.
stops.english: Lake Neusiedl has been known as the "Sea of the Viennese" since 1927, when the first bathing facility opened in Neusiedl - today a modern, well-kept, quiet lido.

stops.name: salt pans
stops.quote: Salt pans, reed beds and incredible biodiversity – Neusiedler See–Seewinkel National Park is a landscape full of contrasts and surprises.

stops.name: visitor centre in Illmitz
stops.quote: Tours start at the visitor centre in Illmitz – the ideal gateway to exploring this vast, peaceful steppe lake.
